abstract: Many facets of content creation and distribution affect one's perceptual experience–from the physical attributes of the content itself through to the methods of storage and delivery. All of these systems combined culminate in the audience's Quality of Experience (QoE), and to ensure a high QoE, each system needs its own metrics in place, with workflows that enable those metrics to be captured and monitored reliably.
